Hinweise zur Angebotsabgabe Anzahl Bewerber In Einklang mit § 51 Abs. 2 VgV wird die Zahl der zur Angebotsabgabe aufzufordernden Bewerber auf mindestens drei und höchstens fünf festgelegt. Die festgelegte Mindestzahl von drei Bewerbern entspricht den gesetzlichen Anforderungen für das Verhandlungsverfahren mit Teilnahmewettbewerb. Die vorgesehene Höchstzahl von fünf Bewerbern gewährleistet einen ausreichenden Wettbewerb und ermöglicht zugleich eine sachgerechte und wirtschaftliche Durchführung des weiteren Vergabeverfahrens. Der Auftragsgegenstand umfasst die Konzeption, Entwicklung, Implementierung und betriebliche Optimierung einer innovativen KI-basierten Individualsoftware. Die Prüfung und Bewertung der Angebote erfordert eine vertiefte fachliche Analyse der vorgeschlagenen Lösungsansätze sowie gegebenenfalls die Durchführung von Verhandlungsgesprächen. Mit zunehmender Zahl der einzubeziehenden Bieter steigt der hierfür erforderliche personelle und zeitliche Aufwand erheblich. Die Begrenzung auf höchstens fünf Bewerber dient daher dem Ziel, einen wirksamen Wettbewerb sicherzustellen und gleichzeitig ein effizientes und verhältnismäßiges Vergabeverfahren zu ermöglichen. Nach Einschätzung der Auftraggeberin ist bei einer Teilnehmerzahl von bis zu fünf Bewerbern ein ausreichender Wettbewerb gewährleistet. Sofern mehr als fünf geeignete Bewerber einen Teilnahmeantrag einreichen, erfolgt die Auswahl der zur Angebotsabgabe aufzufordernden Bewerber anhand der in den Vergabeunterlagen veröffentlichten Auswahlkriterien und der hierzu festgelegten Auswahlmatrix . SECTION A - BACKGROUND INFORMATION 1.Introduction The Health Service Executive (HSE) was established in January 2005 as the single body responsible for meeting Ireland’s health and social care needs. Programme Aim The purpose of this training programme is to design, develop and deliver a training programme that build people’s understanding of self-harm and the role it plays in the life of a person who self-harms. The programme will build the knowledge and confidence of the learner to have a conversation if they are concerned that someone may be self-harming. The training programme should provide people who access it with a sense of hope and reassurance that people can build healthier coping mechanisms. Programme Objectives The training programme is intended to: Increase understanding of what self-harm is. Increase understanding of the relationship between self-harm and suicide. Challenge the stigma surrounding self-harm Increase awareness of available supports and services Stage 1: An introduction to the subject of self-harm – communicating the ‘why’ functions of self-harm through lived experience experts. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

Scope The contractor shall furnish and deliver one (1) new trailer-mounted vacuum excavator system for use by the 88th Communications Squadron cable maintenance section. 2. Purpose The equipment is required to support the safe location and excavation of delicate buried fiber optic cables and the removal of water and organic sludge from manhole systems. 3. nt • Shall include a hose support arm, boom, or equivalent mechanism capable of supporting and positioning hoses over the excavation area. • Shall include all trailer components required for safe towing, transport, and field operation. 3.6 Hoses, Tools, and Accessories • Shall include hoses, fittings, tooling, and accessories necessary for normal operation. • Shall include all pumps, controls, tanks, and associated components required for the system to perform its intended mission upon delivery. 3.7 Documentation • Shall include operator manuals, maintenance documentation, and warranty information at time of delivery. 4.
